objections.about: Step 2 says none of the three endpoints edits or deletes a comment. The sections only say three endpoints exist to list, read and post comments. They never say that editing or deleting is unsupported, so the reply draws that conclusion itself.

The customer asked whether Blotato can edit or delete the comment at all. The reply doesn't say whether the web app can, and step 3 only points to a page the sections don't describe. The sections also list a `deleted` status ('Removed from the social platform') without saying how a comment gets that status.
